title: SAHA increases chaperone expression and reduces Z-alpha-1-antitrypsin polymers in a patient specific iPSC-based liver model for alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency.
snippet: The severe phenotype of alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency (AATD) is typically caused by the Z-mutation within the SERPINA1 gene. The Glu342Lys substitution causes misfolding and polymerisation of the alpha-1-antitrypsin (AAT) protein and its accumulation in the ER. title: Macrophage lipid signaling drives glioblastoma invasion and represents a therapeutic vulnerability.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by diffuse infiltration into the surrounding brain, limiting complete surgical resection, the strongest determinant of patient survival. title: Schwann cell reprogramming and immune regulation in the cancer microenvironment.
snippet: Schwann cells are peripheral glia with established roles in nerve support and repair. In cancer, tumor-derived factors, inflammatory mediators and metabolic stress can redirect this repair program and generate tumor-associated Schwann cell (TASc) states.
